elena (sec-eng): Auditor asked for a packaged artifact of recent RBAC changes + auth logs. They want verifiable chain-of-custody and proof the bundle was KMS-wrapped. Can we provide presigned download links instead of sharing raw bucket access?
ben (infra): Yes — we can generate time-limited presigned URLs for each artifact. How long does the auditor need? 24h or 72h? Also we'll include a manifest and sha256 checksums.
jane (auditor_jane): 72h is fine. We need sha256 for each object, the KMS key id used to encrypt the archive, and a control mapping (which SOC2/ISO control each file demonstrates). A short README describing redactions is useful.
sanjay (prodops): For chain of custody we should include an operations manifest: who created the bundle, exact command used, upload timestamp, and KMS envelope metadata. Suggest CSV manifest with: path, sha256, s3_uri, kms_key_id, created_by, created_at, control_refs, redaction_notes.
elena (sec-eng): Agreed. Ben, can you drop the presigned URL snippet so we can include it in the manifest?
ben (infra): Snippet below (Python boto3):
```python
import boto3
from datetime import timedelta

s3 = boto3.client('s3')
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('get_object', Params={'Bucket':'redwood-evidence','Key':'rbac-export-2026-02-15.zip'}, ExpiresIn=259200)  # 72h
print(url)
```
kai (compliance): Also include evidence of server-side encryption in the bundle — run `aws s3api head-object` on the key and save the JSON that shows `ServerSideEncryption` and `SSEKMSKeyId`. Put that JSON in /proofs/head-object-rbac-export.json.
jane (auditor_jane): Also include the RBAC PR link and the vuln triage issue that triggered the change (ticket ID and timeline). Redactions for PII are allowed but must be annotated in the manifest with reason.
elena (sec-eng): We'll add a signed ops note: who ran the export and a signed email from sec confirming the snapshot integrity. Not PGP for this handoff, just a signed human email for now.
ben (infra): Upload started by CI job: `devops-bot` -> `s3://redwood-evidence/rbacevidence/rbac-export-2026-02-15.zip`
devops-bot: upload completed: rbacevidence/rbac-export-2026-02-15.zip -> s3://redwood-evidence/rbacevidence/rbac-export-2026-02-15.zip
ben (infra): Upload verified locally. sha256: 3f8b2c1a9b4d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde123. KMS Key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456-7890-abcd1234ef56.
sanjay (prodops): We'll also include `incidents_map.csv` linking any incident IDs and the evidence files (columns: incident_id, linked_file, reporter, timeline_link). For example E-324 -> rbacevidence/rbac-export-2026-02-15.zip.
kai (compliance): Please document sampling method in the manifest: we sampled 5 exports across the last 6 months (seeded rng=42, exclude exports <10MB). Include the seed + query used against the internal audit index so auditor can reproduce selection.

elena (sec-eng): Ignore the stray token, fixed.
elena (sec-eng): Manifest draft (we'll attach full CSV in the bundle):
```
file,path,sha256,s3_uri,kms_key_id,created_by,created_at,control_refs,redaction_notes
rbac-export-2026-02-15.zip,/rbacevidence/3/...,3f8b2c...,s3://redwood-evidence/rbacevidence/rbac-export-2026-02-15.zip,arn:aws:kms:.../abcd-ef12-...,elena@redwood.com,2026-02-15T19:12:34Z,SOC2-CC6.1|ISO27001-A.9.4,none
head-object-rbac-export.json,/proofs/head-object-rbac-export.json,<sha256>,s3://...,arn:aws:kms:.../abcd-ef12-...,ben@redwood.com,2026-02-15T19:13:01Z,SOC2-CC6.1,none
incidents_map.csv,/meta/incidents_map.csv,<sha256>,s3://...,arn:aws:kms:.../abcd-ef12-...,sanjay@redwood.com,2026-02-15T19:13:30Z,SOC2-CC5.3,E-324: redacted broken link
```
elena (sec-eng): Auditor, do you need PGP-signed manifest or is the human-signed email enough for now?
jane (auditor_jane): Human-signed email is fine for this batch. For future recurring evidence, we'll request an HSM or PGP-signed artifact to reduce manual verification. Also please DM the presigned links to me instead of posting here.
ben (infra): We'll set presigned expiry=72h and add a manifest field: `access_policy: presigned, expire=72h, delivered_to: auditor_jane`. Also tag the S3 object with `evidence: true` and `audit_period: Q1-2026`.
kai (compliance): One more thing — retention metadata. Add a top-level README noting how long we retain the export in the evidence bucket (90 days by default) and that presigned links are one-time, short-lived.
elena (sec-eng): Will do. I'll DM @auditor_jane the URL + signed email and attach the full zip to the evidence tracker. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
jane (auditor_jane): Received DM, downloading now. I will verify sha256 and head-object JSON, then respond with acceptance or questions.
ben (infra): noted. I'll also attach the exact `aws s3api head-object` output (redacted account ids) in the bundle for transparency.
elena (sec-eng): Closing the loop — ops playbook entry updated under `/playbooks/audit-handoffs.md` with the steps we used. If auditor asks for anything else ping here.
jane (auditor_jane): Looks good so far. Expect a short follow-up on the redaction rationale. Thank you.
